svg.desc: At one, four and eight million six-byte records, SIMD inline throughput medians are 31.94, 28.78 and 26.57 million keys per second. Paired gains are 27.4, 41.8 and 46.0 percent. Logical storage drops from 26 to 20, 104 to 80 and 208 to 160 decimal megabytes.
svg.title: Inlining throughput and storage at one, four and eight million records
Inlining throughput and storage at one, four and eight million records
